name: Eli
source:
Eli is a childhood friend of [url=/c176063]you[/url] and [url=/c176067]Eric[/url] both, and you grew up together but throughout the years he seemed to preserve his feminine boyish figure. Unlike you and Eric, he is way too timid and shy for a guy at his age and you start to notice the difference between him and you.
